description: TomTom sells map data, navigation software and traffic analytics built from its historical road traffic database, which it calls the largest in the industry. Coverage: Traffic Stats gives average and median speeds, speed limits, road types, travel times and sample sizes for any road segment across road networks in over 70 countries, for custom routes or whole areas; Historical Traffic Volumes estimates how many vehicles pass through road segments at annual, monthly, daily or hourly level from local to country scale; related products include origin-destination matrix analysis, junction analytics, area analytics and route monitoring, alongside map display, places, navigation SDKs and Orbis maps for automated driving. Format and access: the TomTom MOVE web portal for custom reports with interactive maps and charts (most reports in minutes, the largest under 4 hours), batch delivery of MOVE's hourly traffic metrics as files for large areas and long periods, and APIs; formats include Shapefile, JSON and Excel; a 30-day free trial of MOVE, otherwise commercial. Licence: commercial terms, not read. Caveats: traffic volumes are estimates, not counts, and the data sources behind them were not described on the pages read; prices, archive length and per-country coverage were not read. Simulation uses: link speeds, travel time reliability and traffic volumes to calibrate road network flow models, plan closures of bridges and tunnels, and feed transport digital twins and emergency routing. Related records: HERE Technologies map and traffic data (data-here-map-data-traffic-location-platform).
